text:
maru_sales: FYI sales intake from NimbleHealth — they want us to onboard phoenix-7b-fp16 and pin it for them in ap-southeast-1. Primary use: clinical note summarization, determinism required for audits. They asked for an ETA and whether we can offer a dedicated pin or region restriction.

sophia_pm: Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: (1) Is this request blocking a contract start? (2) Expected QPS / peak tokens? (3) Any strict latency SLA?

maru_sales: (1) Not blocking, but contract contingent on region + pin confirmation. (2) ~10 qps steady, bursts to 40 qps. Average request ~600 tokens. (3) They asked for p99 < 1s for 512 tokens; willing to pay reserved capacity if needed.

ben_engineering: My initial take: phoenix-7b-fp16 looks like it will run well on T4/A10s with fp16 path. Need quantization profile test (int8 fallback) for cost. Also need to validate KV-cache compatibility for summarization flows.

eva_research: Also flagging model quality/regression checks — request deterministic seeding and sampling constraints. We'll need evals on their prompt set (they can supply 200 sample prompts).

sophia_pm: Proposal for intake triage: create a backlog ticket with acceptance criteria: 1) runtime perf: p50/p95/p99 latency for 128/512 tokens, 2) functional: match baseline accuracy on their eval set (metric TBD), 3) security: static scan + no external data exfil, 4) region packaging: AMI/container available in ap-southeast-1, 5) billing mapping & pin config. If all green, mark as "priority: high" and schedule for next Dedicated sprint. Thoughts?

ben_engineering: Sounds good. Add: quantization compatibility matrix + fallback policy doc (how we route to alternative model if capacity). Also add a smoke test in the runtime: 3 warmup requests, verify KV-cache reuse and deterministic output with seed. Example smoke snippet we can use:```bash
# smoke test
curl -sS -X POST https://dev.local/v1/generate -d '{"model":"phoenix-7b-fp16","input":"Summarize: \"Patient notes...\"","seed":42}' | jq .output
```

onboard-bot: Checklist generated: [ ] create-catalog-entry, [ ] perf-bench, [ ] quant-test, [ ] region-build, [ ] customer-evals, [ ] security-scan, [ ] docs + pricing. Assigned: product-eng.

jamie_support: I'll ask NimbleHealth for the 200 prompt eval set and expected acceptance thresholds. Also confirm if they need dedicated capacity billing or just model pin + region availability.

sophia_pm: Prioritization: using our simple scoring (customer ARR, compliance needs, technical lift, strategic footprint APAC) I score this a 7/10 — high enough for next sprint planning if engineering estimates < 3w. Ben, can you do a quick feasibility estimate (infra + bench) by EOD tomorrow?

ben_engineering: I'll run a CI perf pass and quantization smoke tomorrow, estimate will be posted here. Tentative effort: 2 eng-days + 1 infra-day to build region image.

maru_sales: NimbleHealth is fine with a 2–3 week window if that means we can pin and confirm region. They also asked about data residency controls — can we confirm KMS/HSM support in ap-southeast-1?

eva_research: KMS integration is standard, but confirm with infra. Also confirm that private deployment (VPC) option is documented for them.

ben_engineering: Ok I'll include KMS checklist in the infra task. If perf/quant looks good, recommend we accept into backlog as "priority: high (customer-request)" and schedule in next sprint.

sophia_pm: Decision for now: create product backlog ticket with the acceptance criteria above, assign to ben_engineering and infra for region build. sales: collect eval set and thresholds. If eng estimate <= 3w, move to next sprint. Marking thread as action item. :thumbsup:

maru_sales: I'll follow up with NimbleHealth and post the eval set here when I have it. Thanks all.

onboard-bot: Ticket created -> PROD-8472 (phoenix-7b-fp16: NimbleHealth onboard + ap-southeast-1 pin)
